## Summary

Describe the change and the artifact or module it affects.

## Validation

List the commands used to verify this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I changed only files owned by my role.
- [ ] I rebased on the latest `main` before pushing.
- [ ] I did not commit `.env`, credentials, or personal information.
- [ ] I did not hard-code an absolute local path.
- [ ] I did not change a frozen function signature or data contract.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks or scripts.
- [ ] I did not commit `data/` unless I am R1.
